title: Detailed paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8772e'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8a24a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8601f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ferrule' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9aa4ad'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#eef4f8'/>
      <stop offset='65%' stop-color='#cfd8de'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7f8a93'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bristles' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f6d98a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e0b85a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b98c34'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='paint' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6fa0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8357a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M46 6 L50 6 L54 6 L58 44 L42 44 Z' fill='url(#handle)'/>
  <path d='M50 8 L51.5 8 L55 43 L49.5 43 Z' fill='#f6c07a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M44 20 L44 38' stroke='#a05a1c' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- ferrule -->
  <rect x='40' y='44' width='20' height='14' rx='2' fill='url(#ferrule)'/>
  <rect x='41' y='46' width='18' height='2' fill='#fdfefe' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='41' y='50' width='18' height='1.5' fill='#8b959c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='41' y='54' width='18' height='1.5' fill='#8b959c' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d='M41 58 L59 58 L55 84 Q50 90 45 84 Z' fill='url(#bristles)'/>
  <path d='M45 60 L47 82' stroke='#c99a3f' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 60 L50 86' stroke='#c99a3f' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M55 60 L53 82' stroke='#c99a3f' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M42.5 63 L44 80' stroke='#f8e6a8' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M57.5 63 L56 80' stroke='#f8e6a8' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- paint tip -->
  <path d='M45 83 Q50 89 55 83 L56.5 92 Q50 98 43.5 92 Z' fill='url(#paint)'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='87' r='1.6' fill='#ffa7c6'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='86' r='1.3' fill='#ffa7c6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='93' r='1.5' fill='#e8579b'/>
</svg>
